name: 06-v0001-metrics
argv: const fs=require('fs'),crypto=require('crypto');const p=process.argv[1],bytes=fs.readFileSync(p),text=bytes.toString('utf8'),body=text.split(/\r?\n/).slice(1).join('\n');console.log(JSON.stringify({path:p,sha256:crypto.createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex'),bytes:bytes.length,body_han:(body.match(/\p{Script=Han}/gu)||[]).length,body_non_whitespace:Array.from(body.replace(/\s/gu,'')).length,measured_at:new Date().toISOString(),draft_mtime:fs.statSync(p).mtime.toISOString(),method:'Remove first Markdown title line; Unicode Script=Han codepoints and non-whitespace codepoints independently.'},null,2));
